verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a CLI secret scanner with git, dir and stdin scanning, pre-commit hooks, custom rules, baselines and a GitHub Action. A security product of this kind could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows an assistant or any way to delegate tasks to AI inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
